name: adhd-reader
description: Bolds the first letters of each word in Claude's replies so text is easier to scan. Toggle with one click, five intensity levels, nine languages.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the ADHD Reader labels and messages. Type a name or code: English, Türkçe, Español, Português (Brasil), Deutsch, Français, Русский, 日本語, 简体中文 (or en, tr, es, pt-BR, de, fr, ru, ja, zh-Hans). Auto uses English.

showBand.title: Show band
showBand.description: Show the ADHD Reader controls above the prompt.
